outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart of Tmprss11b normalized counts with individual biological replicate data points overlaid as colored dots (red/blue/orange) for each mouse model group, alongside mean ± SD bars.
Panel B is a schematic illustrating the experimental workflow, not a plot of quantitative data.
Panel C shows representative MRI images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope micrographs with annotated regions, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images with annotations, not a plot of averaged data.
